name: Ossuary Blade Bearer
languages: Understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The bearer makes two attacks, using Greatsword or Greatsword Hurl in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Splintering Edge.

Actions.name: Greatsword
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. 21 (5d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

Actions.name: Greatsword Hurl
Actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +7, range 60/240 ft. 18 (4d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

Actions.name: Splintering Edge
Actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 14, one creature within 10 feet. *Failure:* The target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn.
Actions.clause: When the bearer hits a creature with its Greatsword, bone shards from the blade's notched edge lodge in the wound; the t
Actions.expresses: a greatsword still gripped in death

Traits.name: Great Weapon Master
Traits.text: When the bearer hits a creature with its Greatsword, the attack deals an extra 3 damage.

lore: Raised from a battlefield ossuary by a necromancer who needed a blade that would never tire, it wanders the old killing fields still hefting the greatsword it died gripping, seeking the next line to break.

generation.cite: composition after Hill Giant (CR 5) — two of the same swing, thrown rock
